channel.title: Cote d'Ivoire - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Cote d'Ivoire, every source cited.

item.title: FBI shares data on Ivory Coast financial court corruption
item.description: Ivorian gendarmes arrested one person after receiving information from the FBI about a corruption network within the financial court.

item.title: 37 French firms seek Ivory Coast contracts
item.description: A delegation of French companies is visiting Nigeria, Senegal, and Ivory Coast to secure business deals.

item.title: Ivory Coast exits GAFI's enhanced surveillance list
item.description: The nation has completed a 24-month reform process to be removed from the financial watchdog's grey list.

item.title: Ivory Coast launches online birth certificate platform
item.description: The ONECI introduced a digital system on October 23, 2026, to combat fraud and streamline document issuance.
